title: East Boulevard filmed assault involving Di-Quan Schafar Hunt

data.name: East Boulevard filmed assault
data.description: Charlotte-Mecklenburg police and local reporting identified Di-Quan Schafar Hunt as the suspect in a July 30, 2026 assault recorded on social media. Reporting says a woman was punched on the sidewalk and suffered serious but non-life-threatening injuries. Victim identity intentionally omitted.

temporal.precision: WSOC reported approximately 8:45 a.m. local time
